definitions.explanation: An official judgment or sentence pronounced in a court of law.
A formal pronouncement or declaration, especially of serious matters like medical diagnoses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The judge pronounced a guilty verdict.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: They received a sentence of 10 years imprisonment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控訴|こうそ}した→控訴：05966_kouso⟧。
examples.english: The defendant who received a death sentence appealed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{余命|よめい}→余命：21080_yomei⟧3⟦か{月|げつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor declared that they had three months to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It felt like receiving a death sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦がん→癌：02629_gan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宣告|せんこく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧。
examples.english: They were diagnosed with cancer but recovered after treatment.

notes:
FORMATION: {宣|せん} (proclaim) + {告|こく} (announce).

LEGAL CONTEXT:
- ⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧{宣告|せんこく} (pronouncement of guilt)
- ⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧{宣告|せんこく} (death sentence)
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧{宣告|せんこく} (pronouncement of judgment)
- {宣告|せんこく}⟦{猶予|ゆうよ}→猶予：13496_yuuyo⟧ (suspended sentence)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
- ⟦{余命|よめい}→余命：21080_yomei⟧{宣告|せんこく} (prognosis of life expectancy)
- ⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧{宣告|せんこく} (cancer diagnosis)

FIGURATIVE USE: Often used metaphorically for any devastating or final pronouncement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧ - the judgment/verdict itself
- {宣告|せんこく} - the act of pronouncing it
